resources.title: Responsive phone shell template
resources.content: .cc-phone-shell { position: relative; aspect-ratio: 9 / 20; border: 1px solid var(--cc-accent); border-radius: 2rem; padding: .7rem; background: linear-gradient(145deg, #27303a, #090b11 40%, #202633); box-shadow: 0 2rem 5rem #000b, 0 0 2rem color-mix(in srgb, var(--cc-accent) 35%, transparent); }
